title: Basic index search
description: Search all events in the 'main' index — the starting point for most investigations.

title: Search a specific sourcetype
description: Restrict a search to events of a specific sourcetype, e.g. web access logs.

title: Count events
description: Count the total number of matching events.

title: Count by field
description: Count matching events grouped by a field value, e.g. per source IP.

title: Top values of a field
description: Show the most common values of a field along with their count and percentage.

title: Rare values of a field
description: Show the least common values of a field — useful for spotting anomalous outliers.

title: Timechart of events
description: Plot event counts over time, bucketed into a chosen span (e.g. hourly).

title: Timechart by field
code: index=main | timechart span=1h count by sourcetype
description: Plot a time series of counts, broken out into a separate series per field value.

title: Transaction command
description: Group related events sharing a field (e.g. session_id) into a single transaction, useful for reconstructing sessions.

title: Extract fields with rex
description: Extract a new field from raw text using a regular expression, without editing the sourcetype's field extraction config.

title: Eval a new field
description: Compute a new field with an expression, here converting bytes to megabytes.

title: Conditional eval (if)
description: Create a field whose value depends on a condition — commonly used to bucket severity/risk.

title: Lookup enrichment
code: index=main | lookup threat_intel.csv ip AS src_ip
description: Enrich events by joining against a lookup table (e.g. matching source IPs against a threat-intel feed).

title: Where filter
description: Filter results using a boolean expression, similar to a SQL WHERE clause — useful for numeric comparisons that 'search' syntax can't express directly.

title: Sort results
description: Sort results by a field; a leading '-' sorts descending.

title: Dedup results
description: Remove duplicate events, keeping only the first (most recent) event per unique field value.

title: Stats with multiple functions
code: index=main | stats sum(bytes) as total_bytes avg(bytes) as avg_bytes by src_ip
description: Compute multiple aggregate statistics per group in a single stats command.

title: Failed login events (auth)
description: Search for failed SSH password authentication attempts in Linux auth logs.

title: Windows failed logon (4625)
description: Search for Windows failed-logon events (Event ID 4625) — a foundation for brute-force detection.

title: Windows successful logon (4624)
description: Search for Windows successful-logon events (Event ID 4624).

title: Brute force detection pattern
code: index=main sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | stats count by src_ip | where count > 10
description: Count failed logins per source IP and surface only those exceeding a threshold — a simple brute-force detector.

title: New process creation (Sysmon EventID 1)
description: Search Sysmon process-creation events — the backbone of Windows endpoint threat hunting.

title: Network connection events (Sysmon EventID 3)
description: Search Sysmon network-connection events, useful for spotting C2 beaconing or unusual outbound traffic.

title: Field extraction with table
description: Display results as a table restricted to selected fields, in the given column order.

title: Search within a time range
description: Restrict a search to a relative time window — here, the last 24 hours.

title: Chart command
code: index=main | chart count over src_ip by action
description: Build a chart-ready data structure with one field as rows and another split into columns.

title: Eventstats (non-collapsing stats)
code: index=main | eventstats avg(bytes) as avg_bytes by src_ip
description: Add aggregate statistics as new fields on every original event, instead of collapsing rows like stats does.

title: Streamstats (running totals)
code: index=main | streamstats count as running_total by src_ip
description: Compute a running/cumulative statistic across events in search-result order.

title: Search with wildcard
description: Use wildcards in field values, e.g. matching any sourcetype starting with access_ or any 5xx status code.

title: Boolean OR search
description: Combine multiple conditions with OR — matches events satisfying either condition.

title: Exclude a value (NOT)
description: Exclude events matching a condition, e.g. filtering out a known-noisy monitoring host.

title: Regex match search
description: Filter events whose raw text matches a regular expression, here a rough IPv4 pattern.

title: Append another search
description: Combine results from two separate searches into one result set.

title: Join two searches on a field
code: index=main sourcetype=access_combined | join src_ip [search index=main sourcetype=linux_secure]
description: Correlate events from two different sourcetypes that share a common field value.

title: Stats distinct count
code: index=main | stats dc(src_ip) as unique_sources by dest_ip
description: Count the number of distinct values of a field per group — e.g. how many unique sources hit each destination.

title: First/last time seen
code: index=main | stats earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen by src_ip
description: Find the first and last time each value of a field appeared — useful for scoping an incident timeline.

title: Bin/bucket time manually
code: index=main | bin _time span=5m | stats count by _time
description: Manually bucket the _time field into fixed intervals before aggregating — an alternative to timechart for custom pipelines.

title: Search macro usage
description: Invoke a saved search macro (reusable snippet of SPL) with an argument — improves query maintainability.

title: Data model / tstats acceleration
code: | tstats count from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=failure by Authentication.src
description: Query an accelerated data model with tstats for much faster performance over large time ranges than a raw search.

title: Outlier detection
code: index=main | stats count by src_ip | eventstats avg(count) as avg_count stdev(count) as sd | where count > avg_count + 3*sd
description: Flag source IPs whose event count is a statistical outlier (beyond 3 standard deviations) — a simple anomaly-detection pattern.

title: Search for DNS exfil-style queries
code: index=main sourcetype=dns | eval qlen=len(query) | where qlen > 50
description: Flag unusually long DNS query names, a common indicator of DNS-tunneling-based data exfiltration.

title: PowerShell script block logging search
description: Search PowerShell Script Block Logging events, which capture the actual code executed — key for detecting obfuscated attacker scripts.
